purpose: A real static Closure created in an inherited static method returns static::protected Generator. The factory Closure owns a captured Token that retires before first body entry, while lexical Base and called Leaf remain distinct.
source:
<?php
class Token78A {
    public function __destruct() { echo 'TOKEN|'; }
}
class Base78A {
    protected static function body() {
        echo 'BODY|', (int) (__CLASS__ === 'Base78A'), '|',
             (int) (static::class === 'Leaf78A'), '|';
        yield 78;
        return 79;
    }
    public static function make($token) {
        echo 'MAKE|';
        return static function () use ($token) {
            echo 'CALL|';
            return static::body();
        };
    }
}
class Leaf78A extends Base78A {}
$token = new Token78A();
$weak = WeakReference::create($token);
$factory = Leaf78A::make($token);
unset($token);
$g = $factory();
unset($factory);
echo 'FRESH|', (int) ($weak->get() === null), '|';
echo 'VALUE|', (int) ($g->current() === 78), '|';
$g->next();
echo 'RETURN|', (int) ($g->getReturn() === 79), '|';
unset($g, $weak);
echo 'E';

purpose: A global real Closure boundTo a Leaf receiver with Base lexical scope calls self::protected nonstatic Generator body. The bound factory retires while the saved Generator frame retains This through a real finally close.
source:
<?php
class Base78B {
    protected function body() {
        global $weak;
        echo 'BODY|', (int) ($this === $weak->get()), '|',
             (int) (__CLASS__ === 'Base78B'), '|',
             (int) (static::class === 'Leaf78B'), '|';
        try {
            yield 78;
        } finally {
            echo 'FIN|';
        }
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'MAKER|'; }
}
class Leaf78B extends Base78B {}
$maker = new Leaf78B();
$weak = WeakReference::create($maker);
$template = function () { echo 'CALL|'; return self::body(); };
$bound = $template->bindTo($maker, Base78B::class);
unset($template);
$g = $bound();
unset($bound, $maker);
echo 'KEPT|', (int) ($weak->get() !== null), '|';
echo 'VALUE|', (int) ($g->current() === 78), '|';
unset($g);
echo 'AFTER|', (int) ($weak->get() === null), '|';
unset($weak);
echo 'E';

purpose: A real Closure::call temporarily binds a Leaf receiver, then returns self::protected nonstatic Generator body. The factory retires after call; the Generator preserves This until completion.

        yield 78;
        return 79;
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'MAKER|'; }
}
class Leaf78C extends Base78C {}
$maker = new Leaf78C();
$weak = WeakReference::create($maker);
$factory = function () { echo 'CALL|'; return self::body(); };
$g = $factory->call($maker);
unset($factory, $maker);
echo 'KEPT|', (int) ($weak->get() !== null), '|';
echo 'VALUE|', (int) ($g->current() === 78), '|';
$g->next();
echo 'DONE|', (int) ($g->getReturn() === 79), '|',

purpose: A real static Closure factory enters private self::bridge before protected parent::body. The Closure stops borrowed ancestry, retires before Generator body entry, and transfers lexical Mid/called Leaf through the bridge.

<?php
class Token78D { public function __destruct() { echo 'TOKEN|'; } }
class Base78D {
    protected static function body() {
        echo 'BODY|', (int) (__CLASS__ === 'Base78D'), '|',
             (int) (static::class === 'Leaf78D'), '|';
        yield 78;
        return 79;
    }
}
class Mid78D extends Base78D {
    private static function bridge() { echo 'BRIDGE|'; return parent::body(); }
    public static function make($token) {
        echo 'MAKE|';
        return static function () use ($token) {
            echo 'CALL|';
            return self::bridge();
        };
    }
}
class Leaf78D extends Mid78D {}
$token = new Token78D();
$weak = WeakReference::create($token);
$factory = Leaf78D::make($token);
unset($token);
$g = $factory();
unset($factory);
echo 'FRESH|', (int) ($weak->get() === null), '|';
echo 'VALUE|', (int) ($g->current() === 78), '|';
$g->next();
echo 'DONE|', (int) ($g->getReturn() === 79), '|';
unset($g, $weak);
echo 'E';
